name: Microsoft Agent 365
desc: A control plane that governs every agent running in a tenant.
desc_zh: 一个管控平面，统管租户里运行的所有 Agent。
solves: Agents arrive from several vendors and nobody can see what they did. Agent 365 gives them one identity, one audit trail and one place to block them.
solves_zh: Agent 来自多家厂商，没人看得清它们做过什么。Agent 365 给它们统一身份、统一审计轨迹，也给了统一的叫停入口。
best_for: An IT lead is asked which agents exist and what they touched last week.
best_for_zh: IT 负责人被问到现在有哪些 Agent、上周各自动了什么。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — Microsoft Security Blog, https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2026/）。 Announced 2025-11-18 as the control plane for AI agents; general availability for commercial customers on 2026-05-01, which is just before the discovery window. Absent from the ledger partition list, so proposed under rule (b). Licensed per managing user, also inside Microsoft 365 E7. 首次公开日期来源：https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2026/05/01/microsoft-agent-365-now-generally-available-expands-capabilities-and-integrations/
